commit_message: Harden ADR 0142 benchmark completion and lint
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0142 agent benchmark catalog
pr_body:
## Summary

- Add the versioned GameEngine Agent Benchmark, machine-local evidence records, strict fail-closed comparison identity, loopback installed-model discovery, and evidence-derived curated model profiles.
- Freeze benchmark task, ADR0135 workload classification, and active Editor hardware identity at execution start; Windows records uniquely matched DXGI dedicated VRAM and OS-reported physical RAM without guessing unavailable values.
- Group write-run benchmark identity into an explicit context so the affected Clippy gate stays warning-free instead of suppressing lint.
- Require actual retrieved provenance for the read-question completion gate; a plain answer without evidence remains a recorded benchmark failure and cannot qualify a catalog recommendation.
- Preserve ADR0152 work-claim privacy by comparing kind/count budgets without raw project target keys, and never silently download recommended model weights.

## Validation

- GameEngine Windows Validation
- Editor Visual Validation
